column1: # Facts about third-party components that their own package metadata leaves out or states imprecisely.
# Read by the .NET and Java builds when they write THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, and by scripts/complete-sbom.py when it
# completes a software bill of materials. One fact per line, three fields separated by tabs: the component (a NuGet
# package identifier, or a Maven groupId:artifactId), the field and the value. Lines starting with # are comments.
#   licence       The SPDX licence expression, where the package states none or states it imprecisely.
#   licence-name  The licence's name, for a licence that has no SPDX identifier.
#   licence-url   Where that licence can be read.
#   licence-file  A file in licences/ holding the component's own licence text, for a component that names its licence
#                 without shipping a copy of it.
#   source        Where the component's source code can be obtained.
#   copyright     The copyright line of the component's own licence, for a component whose package carries none and
#                 whose licence requires the notice to be kept.
#   scope         "excluded" for a component the dependency graph names but the published output does not contain.
